component.name: Omni Prism
component.summary: Free, cross-platform image viewer and gallery

description.p: Omni Prism is a fast, distraction-free image viewer with a built-in gallery for browsing the pictures on your computer.

ul.li: View JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, BMP, ICO and SVG images
Gallery that scans the folders you choose and groups your images
Fullscreen viewing with a transparent, minimal interface
Open images directly from your file manager
